description: SmartVisuals Gantt Chart turns Power BI into a real project-tracking tool. Build a schedule with a collapsible work-breakdown hierarchy, watch progress roll up to summary bars, and trace what actually drives your timeline through dependency arrows, critical-path highlighting and plan-vs-actual baselines. Everything is computed locally inside Power BI. No external services, no API keys, no data leaving your report. What you get for free Parent-child task hierarchy with rollup summary bars and expand/collapse, including one-click collapse all. Calendar-aligned two-level time axis with Day/Week/Month zoom and sticky headers that stay in place as you scroll. Milestones as diamonds, circles, stars or flags, with progress bars, overdue highlighting and a today line. Category color coding with an interactive legend, weekend shading, tooltips and full cross-filtering with the rest of your report. Four built-in themes, including the turquoise SmartVisuals look with water-drop milestones, plus report-theme colors and a custom or transparent background. Layout control over bar styles, the time-axis header, row and label layout. Premium features Per-user license, first month free. Dependency arrows - finish-to-start connectors drawn from a simple comma-separated predecessor field. No separate relationship table to model. Critical path - the longest chain through your dependency network,…
